change: tabular-workbook.ts (new): the whole-file workbook read moved out of tabular-source.ts, now for 'xlsx' and 'ods'. For an ODS a cell element's row and column repeats are expanded to the cells they cover (bounded by 2,000 x 256 cells), repeated empty-text or blank padding writes nothing, and a cell element with no value is absent, as a blank XLSX cell is. Marks (no_value, formula_cached, formula_uncached, error, unsupported) are returned beside the table; readTabularSource strips them, so an XLSX table and its fingerprint are unchanged.

An ODS over the bound (native NATIVE_ODS_LIMIT, more than 2,000 records after expansion, or above 16 MiB) is refused 413 TABULAR_ODS_LIMIT and is never sent to the stream job; an XLSX keeps TABULAR_ROW_LIMIT and its stream fallback.

tabular-stream.ts readOdsWindows: placement and the stream profile read an ODS whole (up to 16 MiB) and hand it on as one workbook window; every row cites content.xml's stored bytes in the ZIP (range and SHA-256) and sheetSha256 is the SHA-256 of content.xml as read, so registry-table-evidence's range check holds. readZipMember now also returns dataStart.

Contract: TabularSelection, AnyRetainSource and TableDerivativeLineage format enums gain 'ods'; INTAKE_TABLE_READER_FORMATS gains 'ods'; INTAKE_LEGACY_WORKBOOK_WORDS added; openapi.json, source-pins.json and api-client schema.d.ts regenerated.
table-geojson.ts: the derivative of any workbook is named '<stem> <sheet>.geojson'. intake-service.ts: an ODS card has no child items (no package parts as items).

intake-signatures.ts: an OLE2 header (D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1) is format 'xls', family 'table', when the first directory sector inside the 64 KiB head names a 'Workbook' or 'Book' stream (detectedBy 'bytes') or the name ends .xls (detectedBy 'bytes_and_name'); any other compound file stays unknown. No cell is read; the card's limit and the batch tray carry the kept words.

Studio: .ods routes to the table import alone and to the batch table section in a batch (TableSelectionFields, BatchTableSection, useRetainTable through tableFormat/formatSelection); its forecast ceiling is 16 MiB (ODS table reader) and a larger one says its cells will not be read; .xls joins the batch with the route and forecast words below.

decisions: The task asked for the same refusal words for an ODS over the row limit. The XLSX words say the table 'is read as a stream instead', which is false for an ODS, and that code (TABULAR_ROW_LIMIT) makes the service queue a stream job; an ODS gets its own code and words at the same bound instead.

Expanding ODS repeats follows the ODF meaning of number-rows-repeated and number-columns-repeated; leaving them unexpanded (the base reader's whole read) would drop equal neighbouring cells and equal consecutive rows.
